premises.text: Small and medium businesses struggle to use their energy data effectively.
premises.evidence_span: Businesses are surrounded by energy data, but few of them use it.

premises.text: Energy bills contain multiple pieces of information that can help understand energy usage.
premises.evidence_span: his energy bill actually contains over 30 unique pieces of information, which can help him understand what he's using and what he's spending.

premises.text: Consultants provide energy reports that are often not utilized effectively.
premises.evidence_span: the consultant produces an energy report for him, which shows Sean how he can save by doing some simple actions, which he implements. Then the report sits on a shelf.

premises.text: Energy costs are a significant expense for small and medium businesses.
premises.evidence_span: Energy is one of the top costs for small and medium businesses.

premises.text: Energy data analytics can help businesses make better energy decisions.
premises.evidence_span: Energy Alpha solves this problem by helping businesses build, visualize, and analyze their energy data.

premises.text: External data can enhance energy usage insights for businesses.
premises.evidence_span: We combine Sean's data with external data sources, to show him how he's performing against the best-in-class.

premises.text: Smart meters will increase the availability of energy data.
premises.evidence_span: with the rollout of smart meters, even larger data sets are going to become available.

premises.text: New legislation will require energy certificates for buildings in Europe.
premises.evidence_span: there's also new legislation coming out that ensures that every building in Europe will need an energy certificate of some sort.

premises.text: Energy Elephant offers a free service for users with energy bills.
premises.evidence_span: Anybody can use the Energy Elephant system for free, if they have an energy bill.

premises.text: Paying customers can receive ongoing and in-depth analysis for a low fee.
premises.evidence_span: we charge us a fee of less than £1 per day, per site.

premises.text: Energy Elephant has identified significant cost savings for its customers.
premises.evidence_span: we've identified cost savings of an average of 15% for our paying customers.

value.text: Businesses can make better energy decisions and reduce costs through data analysis.
value.evidence_span: helping them reduce their costs by thousands and reduce their environmental impacts.

notes: Consultant reports and energy bill analysis are separate premises due to different changes required if wrong.
